title: The Drum Call Summons the Misls Back to Morinda

blocks.text: Once the insult and shooting are reported, senior leaders are briefed and the attack on Morinda is launched in earnest. The narrative stresses that this is not a private retaliation by a few offended men, but a deliberate response taken up by the Khalsa leadership.

Many misls turned back at the drum beat, and contingent after contingent rejoins the action. The page takes care to present the return of these bodies as a collective rally, giving the coming assault the force of the wider Panth rather than a single jatha.

With that strength gathered, the Khalsa attacks Morinda from all sides. Yet the defenders still manage to withdraw into a formidable fort, so the page ends with the assault underway but not yet complete.
